-- Hashmi Bomb Multi-Tab GUI (Stepped Ticking Clock Hand & 20 Min Continuous Sound)

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Theme = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10),
    panel = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18),
    card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
    cardHover = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 200),
    accentBright = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    accentDark = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80),
    text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250),
    muted = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150),
    off = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65),
    knobOn = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 38),
    verifiedBlue = Color3.fromRGB(29, 155, 240),
}

local function addCorner(parent, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    corner.Parent = parent
    return corner
end

local function addStroke(parent, color, transparency, thickness)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
    stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stroke.Parent = parent
    return stroke
end

local function addGradient(parent, firstColor, secondColor, rotation)
    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(firstColor, secondColor)
    gradient.Rotation = rotation or 0
    gradient.Parent = parent
    return gradient
end

-- تشغيل صوت الساعة والموسيقى بمدة طويلة (20 دقيقة مستمرة وتتكرر)
local function playContinuousSound()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://8966275754" -- صوت التك تك والتناغم الزمني
    sound.Volume = 1
    sound.Looped = true -- تكرار تلقائي ليظل مستمرًا
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()

    task.delay(1200, function()
        if sound and sound.Parent then
            sound:Stop()
            sound:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- دالة إنشاء شارة التوثيق
local function createVerifiedBadge(parent, size)
    size = size or 16

    badgeFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
    badgeFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    badgeFrame.Parent = parent

    local badgeBG = Instance.new("Frame")
    badgeBG.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    badgeBG.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.verifiedBlue
    badgeBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
    badgeBG.Parent = badgeFrame
    addCorner(badgeBG, math.floor(size * 0.3))
    
    local rotFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    rotFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    rotFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.verifiedBlue
    rotFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    rotFrame.Rotation = 45
    rotFrame.Parent = badgeFrame
    addCorner(rotFrame, math.floor(size * 0.3))

    local innerCover = Instance.new("Frame")
    innerCover.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.85, 0)
    innerCover.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    innerCover.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    innerCover.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.verifiedBlue
    innerCover.BorderSizePixel = 0
    innerCover.Parent = badgeFrame
    addCorner(innerCover, math.floor(size * 0.25))

    local checkMark = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    checkMark.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    checkMark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    checkMark.Text = "✓"
    checkMark.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    checkMark.TextSize = math.floor(size * 0.75)
    checkMark.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    checkMark.Parent = badgeFrame

    return badgeFrame
end

local function createExactGothicRings(parentFrame, sizeScale)
    sizeScale = sizeScale or 1
    local outerGear = Instance.new("Frame")
    outerGear.Size = UDim2.new(0, 116 * sizeScale, 0, 116 * sizeScale)
    outerGear.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    outerGear.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    outerGear.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    outerGear.Parent = parentFrame

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local tooth = Instance.new("Frame")
        tooth.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10 * sizeScale, 0, 16 * sizeScale)
        tooth.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        tooth.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        tooth.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accentBright
        tooth.BorderSizePixel = 0
        tooth.Parent = outerGear
        addCorner(tooth, 3)
        
        local angle = math.rad((i - 1) * 45)
        local dist = 52 * sizeScale
        tooth.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(angle) * dist, 0.5, math.sin(angle) * dist)
        tooth.Rotation = (i - 1) * 45
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5 * sizeScale, 0, 5 * sizeScale)
        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accentBright
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.Parent = outerGear
        addCorner(dot, 3)
        
        local angle = math.rad((i - 1) * 45 + 22.5)
        local dist = 48 * sizeScale
        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(angle) * dist, 0.5, math.sin(angle) * dist)
    end
end

local function showNotification(message)

        local notif = Instance.new("Frame")

        notif.Position = UDim2.new(1, 280, 1, -60)

        notif.Parent = screenGui

        addStroke(notif, Theme.verifiedBlue, 0.2, 1.2)

        local icon = createVerifiedBadge(notif, 16)
        icon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -8)

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = message
        lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.text
        lbl.TextSize = 11
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        lbl.Parent = notif

        TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(1, -272, 1, -60)}):Play()
        task.wait(2.8)
        local tweenOut = TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(1, 280, 1, -60)})
        tweenOut:Play()
        tweenOut.Completed:Connect(function() notif:Destroy() end)
    end)
end

local function getTargetPlayer()
    if SelectedTargetPlayer and SelectedTargetPlayer.Character and SelectedTargetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hum = SelectedTargetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then return SelectedTargetPlayer end
    end

    local selectedPlayer = nil
    local maxDist = Toggles.PassTarget and 0 or math.huge
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (myChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if Toggles.PassTarget then
                    if dist > maxDist then maxDist = dist; selectedPlayer = p end
                else
                    if dist < maxDist then maxDist = dist; selectedPlayer = p end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return selectedPlayer
end

local isPassing = false
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if (not Toggles.AutoPass and not Toggles.CrazyFastPass and not Toggles.InvisPass) or isPassing then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    local bombInHand = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not bombInHand then return end

    local timer = bombInHand:FindFirstChild("Time") or bombInHand:FindFirstChild("Timer") or char:FindFirstChild("BombTimer")
    local triggerLimit = (Toggles.InstantPass or Toggles.CrazyFastPass or Toggles.InvisPass) and 999 or 3
    local timeLeft = (timer and typeof(timer.Value) == "number") and timer.Value or 3

    if timeLeft <= triggerLimit then
        local target = getTargetPlayer()
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            isPassing = true
            local originalCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            local targetHRP = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart

            if Toggles.InvisPass then setCharacterVisibility(false) end

            local angle = 0
            local startTime = tick()
            local speedMultiplier = (Toggles.CrazyFastPass or Toggles.FastOrbit) and 1.5 or 0.4

            while char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") and (tick() - startTime < 3.5) do
                if targetHRP and targetHRP.Parent then
                    angle = angle + speedMultiplier
                    local distanceOffset = Toggles.CrazyFastPass and 0.5 or 1.5
                    local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distanceOffset, 0, math.sin(angle) * distanceOffset)
                    char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetHRP.Position + offset, targetHRP.Position)
                    if Toggles.CrazyFastPass then
                        char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(500, 500, 500)
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end

            char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = originalCFrame
            if Toggles.InvisPass then setCharacterVisibility(true) end
            task.wait(0.3)
            isPassing = false
        end
    end
end)
